content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DCPU Nagapattinam Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: http://www.nagapattinam.nic.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 05-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the District Child Protection Unit Nagapattinam (DCPU Nagapattinam) for filling temporary contract positions in Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q2. What positions are available in this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: The notification invites applications for Junior Assistant cum Record Clerk and Office Assistant positions under the District Child Protection Unit.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are announced?
faq.answer: A total of 2 vacancies have been announced across the Junior Assistant cum Record Clerk and Office Assistant posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the offline application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the filled-out offline application form is 5 October 2026 by 5:30 PM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for Junior Assistant cum Record Clerk?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Junior Assistant cum Record Clerk post must have passed the X Standard or its equivalent examination.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for Office Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Office Assistant post must have passed the VIII Standard or its equivalent examination.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit for these positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants across all posts in this recruitment drive is set at 42 years.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary range for these contract posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly pay ranges from Rs. 13,000 for Office Assistant up to Rs. 20,000 for Junior Assistant cum Record Clerk.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for DCPU Nagapattinam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted strictly through offline mode by downloading the form and sending it via post to the designated address.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the completed application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications should be sent to the District Child Protection Officer, District Child Protection Unit, Room No. 209, 2nd Floor, District Collector Office, Nagapattinam – 611 003.
